items.title: Covid Queries: Altered DNA and microchips
items.snippet_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips and cannot track people or gather personal information. This myth originated from Bill Gates' comments about a digital certificate of vaccine records, which was not a microchip and unrelated to vaccine development or distribution.

items.title: Debunking COVID-19 myths
items.snippet_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. They are made only with ingredients that help the body recognize and clear out the virus.

items.title: Myths and Facts about COVID-19 Vaccines
items.snippet_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. They are developed to fight disease, not to track movement.

items.title: Debunking COVID-19 myths
items.snippet_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not have microchips. They are composed of ingredients that help the body fight the virus.

items.title: Do COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips?
items.snippet_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. They are designed to stimulate the immune system.

items.title: Vaksin Covid-19 Punya Chip untuk Lacak Orang? Itu Disinformasi!
items.snippet_en: The claim that COVID-19 vaccines contain chips to track people is false. The barcode on vaccine products is for tracking product distribution, not individuals.
